`final class GlStateJournal`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.opengl.render.state` · **Module:** `base-opengl` · **Source:** [GlStateJournal.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/opengl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/opengl/render/state/GlStateJournal.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 2</span> <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

The record of the OpenGL states that JOID touched since the guard was entered, with their values before the first change.

## Description

The first change of a state during a recording reads and keeps its value; `restore()` writes the kept values back, in the order of [`GlStateKey`](/reference/base-opengl/glstatekey/).
[`JournalGlBinding`](/reference/base-opengl/journalglbinding/) calls its methods for you.

- [The state journal](/build/embedding-in-a-host/#the-state-journal)

## Methods

### Actions

| Returns | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `void` | [start](#GlStateJournal-method-start)() | Starts a recording and forgets what it knew of the active unit, the bound textures and the bound vertex array. |
| `void` | [restore](#GlStateJournal-method-restore)() | Stops the recording and writes back every kept value. |
| `void` | [excludeTexture](#GlStateJournal-method-excludeTexture)(int texture) | Never records the parameters of that texture, a texture of JOID. |
| `void` | [includeTexture](#GlStateJournal-method-includeTexture)(int texture) | Records the parameters of that texture again, once JOID deleted it. |
| `void` | [excludeVertexArray](#GlStateJournal-method-excludeVertexArray)(int array) | Never records the attributes of that vertex array, an array of JOID. |
| `void` | [trackTexture](#GlStateJournal-method-trackTexture)(int texture) | Remembers the texture bound to the active unit. |
| `void` | [trackVertexArray](#GlStateJournal-method-trackVertexArray)(int array) | Remembers the bound vertex array. |
| `void` | [trackActiveTexture](#GlStateJournal-method-trackActiveTexture)(int unit) | Remembers the active texture unit. |
| `void` | [touch](#GlStateJournal-method-touch)(GlStateKey key) | Keeps the value of that state before its first change of the recording. |
| `void` | [touch](#GlStateJournal-method-touch)(GlStateKey key, int container) | Keeps the value of that state of one container, such as one capability or one buffer target, before its first change of the recording. |
| `void` | [saveTexture](#GlStateJournal-method-saveTexture)() | Keeps the active unit and the texture bound to it. |
| `void` | [saveReadBuffer](#GlStateJournal-method-saveReadBuffer)() | Keeps the read framebuffer and its read buffer. |
| `void` | [saveSampler](#GlStateJournal-method-saveSampler)(int unit) | Keeps the active unit and the sampler of that unit. |
| `void` | [saveFrameBuffer](#GlStateJournal-method-saveFrameBuffer)(int target) | Keeps the framebuffers bound to that target: the draw one, the read one, or both. |
| `void` | [saveTextureParameter](#GlStateJournal-method-saveTextureParameter)(int name) | Keeps that parameter of the bound texture, unless the texture belongs to JOID. |
| `void` | [saveVertexAttribute](#GlStateJournal-method-saveVertexAttribute)(int index) | Keeps that attribute of the bound vertex array, with the array and the array buffer, unless the array belongs to JOID. |
